stem: Which sentence should Roland add to the end of his paper to bring it to a better close?

options.label: A
options.text: For people who don’t think that they want a hedgehog for a pet, we can talk about another unusual animal next.

options.label: B
options.text: I’m going to look on the Internet to find a hedgehog breeder right now.

options.label: C
options.text: If you’re in the market for something unusual, this little animal could be the perfect pet for you!

options.label: D
options.text: And it seems like the perfect time for me to close this paper by saying that hedgies are great!
